affected_boundaries: free-form host tool input to command extraction

observed_behavior: The same coordinator JavaScript is recognized as object-shaped code but ignored as a free-form string.
expected_behavior: Both supported input forms use the same command extraction and authenticated binding checks.
causal_mechanism: An object-only input guard returns before free-form JavaScript can reach the existing code extractor.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Boundary extraction assumes one physical representation of semantically identical host input.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A supported representation bypasses all downstream recognition and produces no binding result.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Equivalent supported representations reach one canonical reader and identical ownership checks.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Normalize free-form JavaScript into the existing code input shape before extracting commands.

applicability_conditions: A host provides both object code and free-form JavaScript input.
known_non_matches: Actual live host-hook delivery is not established by invoking the hook in a fixture.
confirmation_evidence: The focused free-form regression failed before the edit and passed afterward; the existing object-code test also passes.
regression_proofs: tests/plan-input-hooks.test.js: free-form code-mode input binds and releases only the authenticated coordinator
